items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Right away I fell in with a guy named Benjy. He had a big restuarant.

ctx.x: And from the time we got there until the time we left, it was food, food, food. I never seen so much hospitality in my life. Everybody was inviting us out somewhere,

you know. Right away I fell in with a guy named Benjy. He had a big restuarant. He looked like a white guy. And I couldn't buy nothing at that restuarant, bar, couldn't buy nothing. And food galore. They'd say, "Hey, Sonny, what you like?" I said, "Man, I love hardshell crabs. Blue-clawed things, big ones." He said, "All right, I'm going to give you a present when you go."
